name: reaper-mcp
description: Austrian precision DAW automation via Reaper with OSC control. 6 portmanteau tools for transport, tracks, project, system, reascript, and orchestrator.

tools.name: reaper_transport
tools.description: Playback control (play, stop, pause, record, position, status)

tools.name: reaper_tracks
tools.description: Track management (list, info, mute, solo, arm, count, bulk)

tools.name: reaper_project
tools.description: Project operations (info, save, marker, render, stats)

tools.name: reaper_orchestrator
tools.description: SG2-to-mix workflow automation (stem_import, fx_chain, regions, full_pipeline)
